snippet.title: Sofia the Witch Curse of the Monster Moon Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer for the demo of Sofia the Witch Curse of the Monster Moon.
A new Gameboy Color game, coming out soon.
Try the demo over on itch.io, play it on the web, on your phone or download the rom and try it on your Gameboy Color.
Made using GBStudio.
